features: 40mm Drivers: Turn up your audio experience to the next level with the boAt Rockerz Trendz Bluetooth Headphones. Powered by 40mm drivers, they deliver bass-rich boAt Signature Sound with crystal-clear tones, so you can get lost in every beat.

50 Hours Playback: Power through long playlists, podcasts, or binge-worthy series with up to 50 hours of nonstop playtime. Whether it’s day or night, your Rockerz Trendz keeps the entertainment flowing.

ENx Technology: Stay connected without interruptions, no matter where you are. With ENx technology, your calls are clear, and background noise is out of the picture. So, you can take calls effortlessly from busy streets, offices, or gaming lobbies.
60ms Low Latency with BEAST Mode: Turn on BEAST Mode and experience low 60ms latency for synced audio and visuals that elevate your gaming to the next level, whether solo or in the squad.

Adaptive Fit with Foldable Design & BT v5.4: Designed for comfort, the Rockerz Trendz features an adaptive fit that keeps you comfortable during long listening sessions. Plus, when you're done, simply fold the earcups and tuck them away with ease.
description: Step into your sound zone and stay immersed in your playlist with the boAt Rockerz Trendz Bluetooth Headphones. Equipped with powerful 40mm dual drivers, these headphones pump out bass-rich boAt Signature Sound that brings every beat, drop, and dialogue to life, whether you're vibing to music, watching a film, or catching up on podcasts. For a competitive edge while gaming, just activate BEASTTM mode and enjoy a smooth performance with the 60ms low latency, keeping audio and visuals in sync. Keep the entertainment going with an impressive 50-hour playback, perfect for those binge sessions or long-haul listening marathons. Designed with comfort in mind, the adaptive fit ensures a snug yet cozy wear, while the foldable earcups make it easy to store and carry these headphones wherever you go. Thanks to Bluetooth v5.4, you can enjoy seamless, wireless comfort whether you're commuting, working out, or simply relaxing at home. Bid goodbye to worries about noisy backgrounds during calls with the built-in ENxTM technology that filters out distractions, giving you clear and focused two-way conversations.
